name: n-variate B-spline Wavelet Lifting Scheme
definition: A lifting scheme that uses narrow filters to limit the influence of wavelet coefficients, addressing the issue that B-spline wavelets normally influence neighbors beyond immediate vicinity.
summary: The n-variate B-spline wavelet lifting scheme is a multiresolution transform for hierarchical volume data that uses narrow filters to localize coefficients, enabling efficient adaptive refinement and view-dependent visualization.
